proposal.title: Campaign timeline — NCC 1983: planned ERA² and Logix Athena premiere
proposal.reason: Convert this campaign to an independent dated timeline object. Dates are resolved from its execution process without changing precision. Preserve all existing event/subprocess ownership; marketing-step reference_id is absent throughout. Consolidate presentations, campaign material and useful claim-policy requirements into narrated steps; remove historical acceptance labels and duplicate import fragments. Product-owned launch links remain authoritative and validated through the explicit transitional execution mapping. Add the campaign alongside the unchanged execution-process step in process.athena_integration.
